# Overview

```{r load_packages}
library(phyloseq)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(vegan)
```

## Input files

```{r check_inputs}
cat("=== DEBUG ===\n")

cat("exists(params): ",
    exists("params"),
    "\n")

} else {

}
```

```{r working_directory}
getwd()
```
## Load data

```{r load_data}
print("params")
otu <- read.table(params$otu, header=TRUE, sep="\t", row.names=1, check.names=FALSE)
tax <- read.table(params$taxonomy, header=TRUE, sep="\t", row.names=1, check.names=FALSE)
meta <- read.table(params$metadata, header=TRUE, sep="\t", row.names=1, check.names=FALSE)

ps <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(as.matrix(otu), taxa_are_rows=TRUE),
  tax_table(as.matrix(tax)),
  sample_data(meta)
)

ps
```

## Sequencing depth

```{r sequencing_depth}
sample_summary <- data.frame(
    Sample = sample_names(ps),
    Reads = sample_sums(ps)
)

DT::datatable(sample_summary)
```

## Taxonomy table

```{r taxonomy_table}
DT::datatable(as.data.frame(tax_table(ps)))
```

## Relative abundance by Phylum

```{r phylum_plot}
ps.phylum <- tax_glom(ps, taxrank="Phylum")
ps.phylum.rel <- transform_sample_counts( ps.phylum, function(x) x / sum(x) ) 
df.phylum <- psmelt(ps.phylum.rel) 
p <- ggplot( df.phylum, aes( x = Sample, y = Abundance, fill = Phylum ) ) + 
    geom_bar( stat = "identity" ) + theme_bw() + 
    theme( axis.text.x = element_text( angle = 90, hjust = 1 ) ) 
ggplotly(p)


ps.phylum.rel <- transform_sample_counts(
    ps.phylum,
    function(x) x/sum(x)
)

df <- psmelt(ps.phylum.rel)
```
## Top 20 Genera
```{r top 20}

ps.genus <- tax_glom(
  ps,
  taxrank = "Genus"
)

ps.genus.rel <- transform_sample_counts(
  ps.genus,
  function(x) x / sum(x)
)

df.genus <- psmelt(ps.genus.rel)

top20 <- df.genus %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  summarise(
    TotalAbundance = sum(Abundance)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(TotalAbundance)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)

df.top <- df.genus %>%
  filter(Genus %in% top20$Genus)

p <- ggplot(
  df.top,
  aes(
    x = Sample,
    y = Abundance,
    fill = Genus
  )
) +
  geom_bar(
    stat = "identity"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )

ggplotly(p)
```

## Alpha Diversity
```{r aplha Diversity}
alpha <- estimate_richness(
  ps,
  measures = c(
    "Observed",
    "Shannon",
    "Simpson"
  )
)

alpha$SampleID <- rownames(alpha)

datatable(alpha)

p <- ggplot(
  alpha,
  aes(
    x = SampleID,
    y = Shannon
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,
      hjust = 1
    )
  )

ggplotly(p)
```
## Beta Diversity (Bray-Curtis PCoA)
```{r beta Diversity}
ord <- ordinate(
  ps,
  method = "PCoA",
  distance = "bray"
)

ord.df <- plot_ordination(
  ps,
  ord,
  justDF = TRUE
)

p <- ggplot(
  ord.df,
  aes(
    Axis.1,
    Axis.2
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  theme_bw()

ggplotly(p)
```
